name: adapter-generic-preview
description: Pinned packages for the Generic Adapter's preview renderer: the versions the fixture project's lockfile resolves for what its components import. scripts/preview.mjs installs them with npm ci --ignore-scripts, never here, into a folder of .scratch/adapter-generic/preview keyed by React's version; react, react-dom and scheduler are replaced there by the versions the project being previewed resolves.
